mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE remains below 5.5% for two consecutive months, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together signal strong economic expansion and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing strength that supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 during late-cycle expansions, or return in this regime is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it triggers expectations of monetary tightening that increases discount rates and contracts equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or average return in high-growth periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 jobs signals accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 in post-recession recovery, or return in this regime is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 102.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate investment and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 102.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
